game_title: Code Reading Relay – Sundial Plaza Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza, a giant sundial plaza: the desert nomad must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza: a giant sundial plaza
core_gameplay_loop: In Sundial Plaza, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the predicted value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the bazaar gate using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The bazaar gate reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the bazaar gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Code Reading Relay' (Week 9 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sundial Plaza'. region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predicted changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Sundial Plaza.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The bazaar gate reached with actions_used <= 21.
